sources.text:
Fulufjellet National Park (Norwegian: Fulufjellet nasjonalpark) is an 82.5-square-kilometer (31.9 sq mi) national park located in Trysil Municipality, Norway. Established on 24 April 2012, its eastern border lies along the Norway–Sweden border and borders the Swedish Fulufjället National Park.
